about: Single user turns that must not be stored as facts saying the proposition happened or holds (negated, question, counterfactual, plan_modal, reported), plus veridical controls that must be stored. Labels written by Claude, not yet reviewed by the owner. Seeds f-015/016/018/020/033/050 come from tests/fixtures/anchored_time/attach_adversarial_fresh.json.
grading: absent: no stored fact or entity summary asserts `proposition` as true; a fact that keeps the modality (User plans to..., User did not..., User asked whether...) passes. present: some stored fact asserts `proposition`.
